comment: Squad video-call cast, all original. The Fleet Admiral is the constant anchor of every run; each run seeds a lineup of `lineup.fleet` pilots/officers from the fleet pool and `lineup.ground` troopers from the ground pool (lib/comms/comms_lineup.dart), avoiding the previous run's lineup. Demon officers are fixed per sector. tools/comms_pipeline.py (voices, grunts, Dart bank) and tools/comms_portraits.py (portraits) read this file. Portrayals are respectful: no caricature, no stereotyped accents; all voices are Kokoro's standard English voices.
